## History

Mrs. Spencer hosted a visit from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to address an adoption mix-up regarding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). During the visit, Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offered to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant, which prompted [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to hesitate and ultimately take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)_

## Relationships

### [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

Spencer is the parent of [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md). During a visit to her home by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to resolve an adoption mix-up, Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a servant, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) decides to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) instead before ultimately keeping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), +2 more_
